preconditions.description: The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 100, inclusive.
The array arr contains exactly 2*e elements representing the edges of the graph.

postconditions.description: The output is either 1 (indicating the graph is biconnected) or 0 (indicating the graph is not biconnected).
